boundary: Offline Workstream L only: no R2 download, no provider operation, no pg_basebackup, no pg_verifybackup, no restore, no pg_ctl, no PostgreSQL query, no production write, and no Gold cleanup.

inputs.role: Stage A/Stage B backup acceptance design
CX1 architecture correction and backup policy source

validations.pattern: /Stage A uses a full plain-format pg_basebackup with required WAL\s+streamed into the backup/
/a full restore into a different local data directory/
/LawMind smoke tests against the restored cluster/
/Acceptance requires pg_verifybackup, a full\s+restore into a different data directory, and LawMind smoke tests/
/R2 remains the initial provider for operational simplicity/

findings.message: minor version differs: source 180004, target 180006 — same major, restore is supported
53 tables compared on exact counts, 0 skipped for lack of an exact count on one side
database size source 107.7 GB, target 120.0 GB (+11.5%) — a fresh restore packs tighter and carries no bloat, so smaller is expected and is not evidence of loss

failedChecks: full-text query uses the GIN index

drillPhases.commandShape: pg_verifybackup <base-backup-dir>; pg_ctl -D C:/lawmind/cx1-lab/dr-restore/<id>/pgdata -o "-p <nonprod-port>" start; psql -p <nonprod-port> -f restore-smoke.sql
drillPhases.boundary: Disposable restore only; never start on 5432 and never point smoke SQL at Gold.

drillPhases.commandShape: Only after Stage A accepted: pg_basebackup --incremental=<ancestor manifest>; pg_combinebackup; pg_verifybackup; full disposable restore.
drillPhases.boundary: Do not enable incremental retention before a successful full restore gate.

acceptanceChecklist.check: Identify exact accepted base backup ID, object keys, backup_manifest path, WAL start/end, and encryption/key procedure.
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: chain manifest or operator-captured backup metadata

acceptanceChecklist.check: Download or mount backup objects from R2 into CX1 disposable storage and hash every object against the source manifest.
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: object hash manifest and byte counts

acceptanceChecklist.check: Run pg_verifybackup against the plain base backup, including WAL parsing.
Restore into a different data directory under C:/lawmind/cx1-lab/dr-restore and start on a non-production port.
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: pg_ctl log, restored data-dir path, port, startup duration

acceptanceChecklist.check: Run restore-smoke.sql only against the restored cluster, not Gold.
Compare extension versions, relation estimates, migration state, representative counts, generated columns, citation lookup, full-text search, vector readiness, and application preflight.
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: comparison report against migration manifests and local smoke baseline

acceptanceChecklist.check: Record backup readback duration, verify duration, WAL replay duration, restored bytes, disk peak, RTO, and effective RPO.
Stop restored cluster and remove only CX1 disposable restore paths after evidence is written.
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: cleanup manifest with deleted paths and bytes

nextGate: HEAVY_IDLE for R2 readback/verify/restore; RESTORED_CLUSTER_ONLY for restore-smoke SQL execution on a non-production port
